The API SLA risk calculator successfully passed all validation tests with a perfect verifier reward, confirming the logic for weighted risk assessment is sound.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.77 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 reported 100% pass rate in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite within 0.73 seconds. While the core logic is reusable, the discrepancy between the verifier and judge rewards suggests potential for further optimization in code style or edge-case handling.
